(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

CACI International Inc is seeking a Junior Software Developer to join an Agile software development team. The role involves building software features, contributing to both client-side and server-side development, collaborating with team members and senior developers, and using industry-standard project management tools.
Junior application developer building software features and managing assigned development work

Responsibilities:
• As a Junior Software Developer, you will be assigned tasks to build features and work closely with more senior developers on your team. You will work with industry standard project management tools including the Atlassian Suite of productivity tools to manage work

Requirements:
• Must be a US citizen (no exceptions)
• Intermediate proficiency in programming, with familiarity with Java/C++ being a plus
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/Engineering
• Experience with Linux

Preferred:
• JavaEE and/or Java Spring
• Angular
• Restful service development
• C++
• Java
• SQL (Postgres/Oracle)
• Netbeans
• Cloud Foundry
• GeoServer
• Git
